turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is your PayLite training coach. We'll do a quick five-question check on the Soundbox. Ready?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, ready.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: First question. What does the Soundbox cost the merchant?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm, is it one ninety-nine a month?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Close! It's ninety-nine rupees a month, and the first month is free.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh yes, ninety-nine, first month free.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question two. Which payment types does it support?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you give me a hint?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. It's UPI only, it doesn't accept cards.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, UPI only.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question three. What documents does a merchant need to sign up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: PAN and bank account... and something else?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And a photo of the shop. GST isn't needed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, PAN, bank account, shop photo.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question four. A merchant says, 'I already have a free QR sticker, why should I pay for a Soundbox?' How do you respond?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'd tell them the Soundbox is better. It's a good product.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Last one. When does the merchant get the money in their bank account?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think it's instant?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Correct, it's instant. Great job, Pooja, that's all five.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you!
